items.title: Al Wynn Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: Now the other records that we made was for Melrose.

ctx.x: That was on the Black Patty.

Black Patty. Now the other records that we made was for Melrose. We made them at Chicago, what is it, Chicago Avenue in the Lake, out there, 17th floor. That's where we made them. But Mr. Melrose, his brother was over there. The old Melrose wasn't there, he said.
